handbook.hours_closures.title: Hours & Closures
handbook.hours_closures.body: We are open Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We are closed on weekends and on the holidays listed in our closure calendar. Families get at least 30 days' notice of any new closure.

handbook.illness.title: Illness Policy
handbook.illness.body: A child must stay home with a temperature of 100.4°F or higher. They may return after 24 hours fever-free without fever-reducing medicine (like Tylenol or ibuprofen). The same 24-hour rule applies after vomiting or diarrhea. If your child develops a fever at school, we will call you and ask for pickup within one hour. Contagious conditions such as pink eye, strep, or hand-foot-and-mouth need a doctor's note or 24 hours of treatment before return.

handbook.lunch.title: Meals & Lunch Policy
handbook.lunch.body: We serve a morning snack, lunch, and an afternoon snack, following the weekly menu. Families may pack their own lunch instead. If you forget lunch, we can provide a backup lunch for $6, billed to your account, if you let us know by 9:00 AM. After 9:00 AM, we will do our best but cannot guarantee it. Our menu is nut-free.

handbook.late_pickup.title: Late Pickup Policy
handbook.late_pickup.body: Pickup is by 6:00 PM. We offer a 5-minute grace period. After that, a fee of $2 per minute applies. If you are running late, please call us so we can reassure your child.

handbook.tuition.title: Tuition & Billing
handbook.tuition.body: Tuition is billed monthly on the 1st, based on your child's age group. There is a one-time $150 registration fee and a $200 annual supply fee. Siblings receive a 10% discount on the lower tuition. Questions about a specific charge are handled by the director.

handbook.tours.title: Tours & Enrollment
handbook.tours.body: Tours are 30 minutes and run Tuesdays and Thursdays at 10:00 AM, 11:00 AM, and 2:00 PM. Please book ahead so the director can meet you. Space availability changes often, so the director confirms openings directly.

handbook.contact.title: Contact & Escalation
handbook.contact.body: Director: Maria Rivera. Phone: (206) 555-0142. Email: frontdesk@littlesprouts.example. For emergencies, call 911 first, then the center. The director replies to non-urgent messages within 2 hours during business hours.
